001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.time.Instant;
004import java.time.ZoneId;
005import java.time.ZoneOffset;
006import java.util.Locale;
007import java.util.function.Function;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.EnumAlias;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.AnsiSupport;
018import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
019
020/**
021 * Pattern Config needed for pattern keywords that is generally platform specific. Through
022 * property configuration there can only be one pattern config but through programmatic
023 * configuration there is no limit by creating custom {@link PatternCompiler}.
024 * <p>
025 * This class is also a configurator for easy programmatic registration with
026 * {@link LogConfig.Builder#configurator(Configurator)}.
027 *
028 * @see PatternCompiler
029 *
030 */
031public sealed interface PatternConfig extends Configurator {
032
033        /**
034         * Formatter properties prefix
035         */
036        public static final String PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.config.{name}.";
037
038        /**
039         * Key Values that can be retrieved by various patterns.
040         * <p>
041         * Property: <code>{@index logging.pattern.property.{name}}</code>
042         */
043        public static final String PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.property.";
044
045        /**
046         * Default zoneId if not specified.
047         * @return zone id.
048         */
049        public ZoneId zoneId();
050
051        /**
052         * Line separator for %n, by default {@link LogFormatter#lineSeparator()}.
053         * @return line separator.
054         */
055        public String lineSeparator();
056
057        /**
058         * Whether color patterns output ANSI escape codes.
059         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#AUTO} follows
060         * {@link LogConfig.Globals#ansiMode()}, and when that is also
061         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#AUTO} whether the console supports ANSI. A global
062         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#OFF} wins over this setting.
063         * @return ANSI mode.
064         */
065        public LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi();
066
067        /**
068         * Key Value function for ad-hoc property replacements and lookup in various patterns.
069         * @return function.
070         * @see #PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX
071         */
072        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
073        public Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction();
074
075        /**
076         * The baseline instant used by <code>%r</code>/<code>%relative</code> to compute
077         * elapsed milliseconds. Captured once (e.g. when this config is built) rather than
078         * recomputed, the same way logback's <code>RelativeTimeConverter</code> captures its
079         * start time once when constructed.
080         * @return start time.
081         */
082        public Instant startTime();
083
084        /**
085         * The first value returned by <code>%lsn</code>. Defaults to <code>0</code>.
086         * @return sequence number start.
087         */
088        public long sequenceNumberStart();
089
090        /**
091         * Whether keywords that can cache their output (currently just
092         * <code>%logger{N}</code> via its abbreviator) actually do so. Defaults to
093         * {@link CacheType#BASIC}.
094         * @return cache type.
095         */
096        public CacheType abbreviatorCache();
097
098        /**
099         * Whether a keyword's own internal caching (currently just <code>%logger{N}</code>'s
100         * abbreviator) is used. {@link #BASIC} is the only real strategy implemented today -
101         * kept as an enum rather than a boolean so a possible future global cache toggle (the
102         * same idea already used for logger name caching and level resolvers) can reuse it
103         * without a breaking property-format change.
104         */
105        public enum CacheType {
106
107                /**
108                 * No caching - every call recomputes.
109                 */
110                @EnumAlias("false")
111                OFF,
112                /**
113                 * The default cache.
114                 */
115                @EnumAlias({ "true", "default" })
116                BASIC;
117
118                static CacheType parse(String value) {
119                        String v = value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
120                        return switch (v) {
121                                case "TRUE", "DEFAULT" -> BASIC;
122                                case "FALSE" -> OFF;
123                                default -> LogProperty.enumValue(CacheType.class, value, "true", "default", "false");
124                        };
125                }
126
127        }
128
129        /**
130         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
131         * @return builder.
132         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
133         * registered at config time easily.
134         */
135        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder() {
136                return builder(LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME);
137        }
138
139        /**
140         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
141         * @param name for property resolution: {@value #PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX}.
142         * @return builder.
143         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
144         * registered at config time easily.
145         */
146        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder(String name) {
147                return new PatternConfigBuilder(name);
148        }
149
150        /**
151         * Copies the config to builder.
152         * @param builder to receive properties.
153         * @param config to copy from.
154         * @return builder passed in.
155         */
156        public static PatternConfigBuilder copy(PatternConfigBuilder builder, PatternConfig config) {
157                builder.ansi(config.ansi());
158                builder.lineSeparator(config.lineSeparator());
159                builder.zoneId(config.zoneId());
160                builder.propertyFunction(config.propertyFunction());
161                builder.startTime(config.startTime());
162                builder.sequenceNumberStart(config.sequenceNumberStart());
163                builder.abbreviatorCache(config.abbreviatorCache());
164                return builder;
165        }
166
167        /**
168         * Default config.
169         * @return default config.
170         */
171        public static PatternConfig of() {
172                return StandardFormatterConfig.DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
173        }
174
175        /**
176         * Platform independent formatter config that will not change across timezones or
177         * platforms. <strong>The zoneId is UTC, line separator is LF, and ANSI is
178         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#OFF}.</strong>
179         * @return config.
180         */
181        public static PatternConfig ofUniversal() {
182                return StandardFormatterConfig.UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
183        }
184
185        /**
186         * Creates a property function.
187         * @param properties log properties.
188         * @param prefix prefix keys before asking LogProperties.
189         * @return function.
190         */
191        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
192        public static Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
193                record LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(String prefix,
194                                LogProperties properties) implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
195
196                        @Override
197                        public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
198                                String key = LogProperties.concatKey(prefix, t);
199                                return properties.valueOrNull(key);
200                        }
201
202                }
203                return new LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(prefix, properties);
204        }
205
206        @Override
207        default boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
208                config.serviceRegistry().put(PatternConfig.class, ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME, this);
209                return true;
210        }
211
212}
213
214non-sealed interface DefaultFormatterConfig extends PatternConfig {
215
216        /**
217         * Default zoneId if not specified. If not overridden the system default will be used.
218         * @return zone id.
219         */
220        @Override
221        default ZoneId zoneId() {
222                return ZoneId.systemDefault();
223        }
224
225        /**
226         * Line separator for %n, by default {@link LogFormatter#lineSeparator()}.
227         * @return line separator.
228         */
229        @Override
230        default String lineSeparator() {
231                return LogFormatter.lineSeparator();
232        }
233
234        @Override
235        default LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi() {
236                return LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.AUTO;
237        }
238
239        @Override
240        default Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction() {
241                return StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE;
242        }
243
244        /**
245         * Captured once when this interface is first loaded so all default configs share a
246         * single start time approximating application/logging startup.
247         */
248        @SuppressWarnings("TimeInStaticInitializer")
249        Instant DEFAULT_START_TIME = Instant.now();
250
251        @Override
252        default Instant startTime() {
253                return DEFAULT_START_TIME;
254        }
255
256        @Override
257        default long sequenceNumberStart() {
258                return 0L;
259        }
260
261        @Override
262        default CacheType abbreviatorCache() {
263                return CacheType.BASIC;
264        }
265
266        enum StandardPropertyFunction implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
267
268                INSTANCE;
269
270                @Override
271                public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
272                        return null;
273                }
274
275        }
276
277}
278
279enum StandardFormatterConfig implements DefaultFormatterConfig {
280
281        DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG(), //
282        UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG {
283                @Override
284                public String lineSeparator() {
285                        return "\n";
286                }
287
288                @Override
289                public ZoneId zoneId() {
290                        return ZoneId.from(ZoneOffset.UTC);
291                }
292
293                @Override
294                public LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi() {
295                        return LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.OFF;
296                }
297
298                @Override
299                public Instant startTime() {
300                        return Instant.EPOCH;
301                }
302        };
303
304        /*
305         * For compilers built without a LogConfig, AUTO is decided by the console alone.
306         */
307        static boolean useAnsi(PatternConfig config) {
308                return switch (config.ansi()) {
309                        case ON -> true;
310                        case OFF -> false;
311                        case AUTO -> AnsiSupport.isAnsiSupported();
312                };
313        }
314
315}
316
317record SimpleFormatterConfig(ZoneId zoneId, String lineSeparator, LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi,
318                Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, Instant startTime, long sequenceNumberStart,
319                PatternConfig.CacheType abbreviatorCache) implements PatternConfig {
320
321}
